#include "syr2k.h"

void kernel_syr2k(
    double alpha,
    double beta,
    double C[30][30],
    double A[30][20],
    double B[30][20]) {

    const int N = 30;
    const int M = 20;

    // Temporary storage for the result
    double C_temp[30][30];

    // Initialize C_temp with beta*C (lower triangular part only)
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
            C_temp[i][j] = beta * C[i][j];
        }
    }

    // Perform the symmetric rank-2k update: C = alpha*(A*B^T + B*A^T) + beta*C
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
            double sum1 = 0.0;
            double sum2 = 0.0;
            
            // Compute A*B^T and B*A^T
            for (int k = 0; k < M; k++) {
                sum1 += A[i][k] * B[j][k];
                sum2 += B[i][k] * A[j][k];
            }
            
            // Update only the lower triangular part
            C_temp[i][j] += alpha * (sum1 + sum2);
        }
    }

    // Copy the result back to C (only lower triangular part)
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
            C[i][j] = C_temp[i][j];
        }
    }
}

#include "syr2k.h"

void kernel_syr2k(
    double alpha,
    double beta,
    double C[30][30],
    double A[30][20],
    double B[30][20]) {

    // Temporary matrix to store intermediate results
    double temp[30][30];

    // Initialize temp matrix to zero
    for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 30; j++) {
            temp[i][j] = 0.0;
        }
    }

    // Compute alpha * A * B^T + alpha * B * A^T
    // Since we're only storing lower triangular part, we compute for j <= i
    for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
            // Compute dot product for A[i][:] * B[j][:] (which is B^T[:][j])
            double ab = 0.0;
            double ba = 0.0;
            for (int k = 0; k < 20; k++) {
                ab += A[i][k] * B[j][k];
                ba += B[i][k] * A[j][k];
            }
            temp[i][j] = alpha * ab + alpha * ba;
        }
    }

    // Update C matrix: C_out = temp + beta * C
    for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
            C[i][j] = temp[i][j] + beta * C[i][j];
        }
    }

    // The upper triangular part remains unchanged (but since we're using lower triangular storage,
    // we don't need to compute it)
}

#include "syr2k.h"

void kernel_syr2k(
    double alpha,
    double beta,
    double C[30][30],
    double A[30][20],
    double B[30][20])
{
    // Perform symmetric rank 2k update: C = alpha*(A*B^T + B*A^T) + beta*C
    // Only lower triangular part of C is computed and stored

    const int N = 30;
    const int M = 20;

    // Temporary storage for intermediate results
    double temp[30][30] = {0};

    // Compute A*B^T and accumulate in temp
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {  // Only compute lower triangular part
            for (int k = 0; k < M; k++) {
                temp[i][j] += A[i][k] * B[j][k];
            }
        }
    }

    // Compute B*A^T and accumulate in temp
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {  // Only compute lower triangular part
            for (int k = 0; k < M; k++) {
                temp[i][j] += B[i][k] * A[j][k];
            }
            // Scale by alpha and add beta*C
            C[i][j] = alpha * temp[i][j] + beta * C[i][j];
        }
    }

    // The upper triangular part remains unchanged as per BLAS syr2k behavior
    // with UPLO='L'
}
